tasks.title: WhatsApp conversations: new customer messages not arriving live; 24h window wrongly blocks send
tasks.brief: Ahmed (owner) just sent a WhatsApp message to the pharmacy number from his phone, but the NOVA conversations screen still shows the last inbound as yesterday 21:26 and blocks sending with 'آخر رسالة منه عدّى عليها أكتر من 24 ساعة'. So live inbound messages are not reaching staging D1 (the history only has the one-time backfill from sheet tab محادثات البوت; bot logged nothing after Oct 25). Diagnose end to end, read-only on the pharmacy repo/Apps Script: is the approved bridge (bot forwards copy of each message to NOVA ingest) merged/deployed and calling the ingest endpoint with NOVA_INGEST_SECRET? Does ingest write into the same tables the history/conversation and send endpoints read? Fix NOVA side so every new inbound/outbound appears in the chat within seconds (polling or SSE, like WhatsApp), and the 24h check uses the latest real inbound timestamp. If the bridge is missing on the bot side, prepare the PR for the pharmacy repo for Ahmed's review only (do not merge). Also make the composer behave like WhatsApp: clear 24h-window state instead of a red banner over messages, auto-refresh after new inbound, sent message shows instantly with ticks. Never send test messages to real customers; never touch WA_TOKEN or Script Properties; no deploy. Build the next worker/live artifact and report the exact root cause.
tasks.acceptance: Root cause stated; new inbound appears live; 24h window computed from latest inbound; tests added; artifact built; no deploy.
